summary_rationale: Kross Limited is a credible, backward-integrated Tier-1 manufacturer of forged M&HCV/tractor components and single-piece extruded trailer axles (scaling trailer systems to ~43%–49% of revenue, with Q2 FY27 sales +80% YoY to Rs 235 Cr and PAT +143% YoY to Rs 19.7 Cr, backed by an IND A / Stable rating). However, it fails the hurdle for a structural compounder because of acute cyclicality (flat Rs 620 Cr sales in FY25), high top-5 customer concentration (~66%–71%, largest single buyer ~15%–16%), severe working capital stretch (working capital days expanded from 30 in FY24 to 124 in FY26; debtor days 107), worsening H1 FY27 cash conversion (H1 CFO collapsed to Rs 4.73 Cr or 14.3% of Rs 33.16 Cr PAT after a Rs 23.89 Cr jump in Other Current Assets, yielding -Rs 54.43 Cr H1 FCF on top of -Rs 111 Cr FY24–FY26 cumulative FCF), ROCE halving from 33% (FY24) to 16% (FY26), rising gross debt (Rs 119 Cr in Sep 2026 guided to ~Rs 165–170 Cr by Mar 2027), two-tranche Oct 2026 preferential dilution (Rs 39.75 Cr upfront cash + Rs 23.85 Cr 18-month promoter warrants), and execution risk monetizing ~50% non-captive surplus from its 1,20,000 TPA Mill 219 seamless tube plant (+Rs 20–25 Cr Cold Drawn Tube line) against a 93%-share domestic incumbent oligopoly (Maharashtra Seamless, Jindal SAW, Kirloskar Ferrous/ISMT).
